findings.current: Cheongpung and Hyuk Mujin had followed Zhuge Feng, so this was the first time I had seen them in almost two full days.
findings.defect: The source says exactly two days, not almost two days.
findings.rationale: 꼭 이틀 means precisely or exactly two days; “almost” changes the stated duration.
findings.replacement: Cheongpung and Hyuk Mujin had followed Zhuge Feng, so this was the first time I had seen them in exactly two days.
findings.source: 그 과정에서 청풍과 혁무진은 제갈풍을 따라갔으니 꼭 이틀 만에 보는 얼굴이다.

findings.current: I thought you might say I was shooting up, then hit me and make me get shot up.
findings.defect: The second half of the Korean means suddenly suffering an injury, while “get shot up” suggests gunfire or being propelled upward.
findings.rationale: The joke splits 급부상, “rapid rise,” into 급 부상, “sudden injury.” The replacement preserves the rise/injury contrast without introducing shooting.
findings.replacement: I thought you might say I was on the rise, then hit me and leave me laid up.
findings.source: 급부상했다면서 때린 다음 급 부상당했다. 뭐 그러실 것 같아서요.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin might be treated like a nobody here, but he was a martial artist who had earned the impressive sobriquet Swift Wind Sword after helping the Jin Family of Taiyuan pacify the northern plateau.
findings.defect: The established place name Gaoyuan is translated generically as “the northern plateau.”
findings.rationale: 고원 is the established location Gaoyuan in the binding glossary.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin might be treated like a nobody here, but he was a martial artist who had earned the impressive sobriquet Swift Wind Sword after helping the Jin Family of Taiyuan pacify northern Gaoyuan.
findings.source: 태원진가의 북부 고원 평정을 통해 쾌풍검(快風劍)이라는 그럴듯한 별호까지 얻은 무인이다.

findings.current: How could Hyuk Mujin possibly resist a grappling technique performed by a Supreme Peak master of the Huashan Sect who had inherited the Sword Saint’s legacy?
findings.defect: The draft omits Cheongpung’s status as Huashan’s Morning Star.
findings.rationale: 화산파의 신성 explicitly identifies him as Huashan’s Morning Star; this is meaningful reputation and hierarchy, not redundant ornament.
findings.replacement: How could Hyuk Mujin possibly resist the grappling technique of Huashan’s Morning Star, a Supreme Peak master who had inherited the Sword Saint’s legacy?
findings.source: 화산파의 신성이요, 검성의 진전을 이은 초절정 고수가 펼치는 금나수(擒拿手)를 버틸 리가 있나.

findings.defect: The draft omits Taekyung’s profane, bewildered reaction.
findings.rationale: 시벌. 저게 뭐야 is an explicit profanity followed by a direct reaction; both are part of Taekyung’s voice and the reveal’s comic timing.
findings.replacement: And on its tail… Fuck. What the hell was that?

findings.current: And according to what I had confirmed personally just one or two shichen earlier, the Gate was still leaking a faint amount of mana despite having lost most of its functions.
findings.defect: The draft weakens a complete loss of function into the loss of only most functions.
findings.rationale: 제 기능을 상실했다 means the Gate had ceased performing its function. “Most of its functions” adds a degree of continued operation absent from the source and alters the Gate’s mechanics.
findings.replacement: And according to what I had confirmed personally just one or two shichen earlier, the Gate was still leaking a faint amount of mana despite having ceased to function.
findings.source: 그리고 불과 한 두시진 전 직접 확인한 바에 따르면, 게이트는 제 기능을 상실했음에도 미약한 마력을 흘리고 있었다.

findings.current: As soon as the Blood Fish were discovered, Great Hero Zhuge Feng ordered the waterways around the entrance to be completely sealed off.
findings.defect: The draft changes one waterway by the entrance into multiple waterways surrounding it.
findings.rationale: 입구 부분의 수로 is singular and locates the waterway at the entrance; that physical containment detail matters to the discussion of escaped Blood Fish.
findings.replacement: As soon as the Blood Fish were discovered, Great Hero Zhuge Feng ordered the waterway by the entrance to be completely sealed off.
findings.source: 혈어의 존재를 확인하자마자 입구 부분의 수로를 완전히 폐쇄하도록 지시를 내리신 분이 제갈 대협이십니다.

summary: Two major fidelity defects affect Hyuk Mujin’s description of Cheongpung and the Gate’s operating state. Additional localized issues alter an exact duration, a place name, a wordplay-based injury, profanity, and the containment mechanism.
